<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **144** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5874d25302cbb80db675eddf1b69198073fbe2a9` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `0f3651d65fe83c5530a155355d7c4396d11e1489` — the merge of head `84615e8cce8eb04f88cd7c7b5b6c56b6d5ee43d1` into base `5874d25302cbb80db675eddf1b69198073fbe2a9`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 0f3651d65fe83c5530a155355d7c4396d11e1489 && git checkout 0f3651d65fe83c5530a155355d7c4396d11e1489
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5874d25302cbb80db675eddf1b69198073fbe2a9 84615e8cce8eb04f88cd7c7b5b6c56b6d5ee43d1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 5874d25302cbb80db675eddf1b69198073fbe2a9 && git merge --no-ff 84615e8cce8eb04f88cd7c7b5b6c56b6d5ee43d1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5874d25302cbb80db675eddf1b69198073fbe2a9
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Run 1 read (run 40144323591, head b2ba3a42da = PR A 7ca50a8a7b + subtree import of objectui main cd70b7818d + adaptation)

**What this run had to show, and did:** with `ui/package.json` present, the `filter` job set `ui_tree=true` and all four new jobs **ran** instead of skipping — Type Check UI, Test UI (16 legs), Lint UI, Build & E2E UI. `Lint UI` is **green** end to end (12 min 13 s cold). Nothing on the existing pipeline that PR A touches behaved differently from #25710's own green run.

**Expected red on this tree (listed in #25710's acceptance notes or on #25697), confirmed:** Validate Package Dependencies (fixed group lacks the 39 `@object-ui/*` — 4a #25711); `check-turbo-task-graph`, `check-workspace-manifest-cycles`, `check-published-files`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-cross-package-test-inputs` (the lint lanes — cutover bill on #25697); Test Core 2–6 (the partitioner enumerates `@object-ui/*` too, and `@object-ui/types#build` under `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` hits TS7016 on `@objectstack/spec/*`).

**Red this run adds to the bill, with the cause measured:**

| Job | Stopped at | Cause | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Build Core | `@objectstack/core#build` DTS: `src/stack-organization-record-page.ts(4,41) TS2307 Cannot find module '@objectstack/spec/ui'` | The ui root is now a workspace member, so root `turbo run build` includes `object-ui-monorepo#build` = `turbo run build --filter=!@object-ui/site`: a **nested turbo run** that rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` a second time (cache miss) and its `Cleaning output folder` raced core's DTS step. Local filtered builds are green because the filter excludes the ui root. | Cutover adaptation: drop the seven turbo-recursive scripts from `ui/package.json` (`build`, `build:all`, `lint`, `type-check`, `typecheck`, `test:dist`, `site:build`). No ported job calls them — every build is a root `turbo run build --filter=…`. Pushed as verify commit 1a76fa5849 → run 2. |
| Type Check UI | `pnpm --dir ui run check:side-effects-array` (before the type-check step; the `@objectstack` build step took 183 s) | `scripts/check-side-effects-array.mjs:282` reads `<objectui root>/pnpm-workspace.yaml`, deleted by the import. | objectui — **sub-issue 2b, #25723** |
| Build & E2E UI | `e2e/record-header-title-width.spec.ts:65` ENOENT `<git root>/packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx` | The spec's `REPO_ROOT` IIFE walks up to the first `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, which is now objectstack's root. Same IIFE in four more specs. `check-ui-root-lookups` is silent on a `readFileSync` of the marker, so this shape escaped #25685. | objectui — #25723 |
| Test UI 15/16 legs (11/16 green) | 4 legs read (1, 9, 12, 16): 5–6 files each | Two classes. (a) **Readers of the four files the import deletes or moves**: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (check-side-effects-array tests, zero-test-member-exclusion, cli workspace-vite tests, CreateViewDialog.chartBinding), `turbo.json` (select-type-check-scope, turbo-lint-inputs, e2e-type-check), `pnpm-lock.yaml` (check-lockfile-dedupe ×10 "a live pnpm reached the registry", check-installed-spec-pin-claims), root `pnpm.overrides` (react-peer-range-norm). (b) **Not attributed to a reader**: `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` "Current Release" must state `workspace:^` (adaptation commit updates the doc); dom/unit tests in app-shell, plugin-list, plugin-grid, core (`MetadataService.objectPayloadFieldsMap`, `CreateViewDialog.sharedSelect-11865`, `ListView.fieldListRead-11984`, `ListView.sort*-11943`, `importWriteModes-12697` RangeError, `reference-keys`, `ObjectView.overrideMasquerade`, …) — this tree compiles objectui against the workspace spec at HEAD instead of its published pin, with the lockfile recomputed (react 19.3.0 line, zod 4.6.7); which of the three it is gets measured on run 3, after the (a) readers are fixed. | (a) objectui #25723; (b) cutover bill on #25697 pending run 3 |
| Lint · PM dispatch-gates | `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `runGit` → `spawnSync git ENOBUFS` in `trackedFiles` | `git ls-files` over the imported tree exceeds `spawnSync`'s default 1 MiB buffer. | objectstack, inert, before cutover: PR A2 on #25697 (with the Test Core partitioner excluding members under `ui/`). |

**Minutes with `ui/` present (cold, no turbo cache):** Lint UI 12:13 green; Type Check UI 4:48 to its red (build step 3:03); Build & E2E UI 6:23 to its red; Test UI legs 9:29–15:05 to their reds; Build Core 3:06 to its red. Type Check UI and Build & E2E UI minutes to green are owed by run 3.

**Next on this PR:** run 2 (1a76fa5849) re-measures Build Core without the nested turbo. Run 3 = #25723's patch as a verify commit, then the spec counter-probe (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts:900`) to prove Type Check UI turns red on a `ui/` file. This PR closes the day its runs are read; nothing here merges.

**Run 2 (40145825496, head 1a76fa5849) — Build Core only; everything else is unchanged from the run 1 read.**

The nested turbo run is gone: with the seven `turbo run …` scripts dropped from `ui/package.json`, the root `turbo run build` ran **117 tasks in 11 min 54 s** (84 objectstack + 33 `@object-ui/*`, cold) and 115 passed, `@objectstack/core#build` among them.

Red = **`@object-ui/app-shell#build`**, a real compile error against the workspace spec:

```
src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx(99,3): error TS1360:
  … is missing the following properties from type 'Record<"positions" | "permissions" | …>': positions, permissions
```

Cause: objectui `main` pins objectstack at `.objectstack-sha` = e649c2d91e; objectstack `main` is 13 spec commits past it, and #25701 (47af3dde42, today) added `positions` and `permissions` as translation kinds. The merged tree compiles the Console against spec HEAD, so the drift shows up at build time — which is the property PR A exists to give us. Two consequences:

1. **Cutover prerequisite (new, carried on #25697):** before the import, objectui must build against the objectstack `main` sha the import will use — bump `.objectstack-sha`, fix the fallout (TranslationPreview today; whatever the 13 commits add), and keep doing so until the cutover PR, since every spec PR merged in the gap widens it. This is also the leading candidate for the dom/unit test failures run 1 could not attribute to a reader. Filed as a sub-issue once run 3 (readers fixed, #25723) shows the full Type Check UI list.
2. **Cutover bill:** the root build now includes `@object-ui/site#build` (`next build`), which objectui's own root build excluded with `--filter=!@object-ui/site`; it failed after app-shell (not read). Decide at the adaptation commit: exclude the site from the root `build` task or give it its own job.

**Run 3 read (40148461539, head 1cade6932a = run 2 + objectui#25723's reader patch dff61d5c8).** The reader class is gone; what is left has one new cause.

| UI job | Run 1 | Run 3 |
|---|---|---|
| Lint UI | green 12:13 | green |
| Build & E2E UI | red at the first e2e spec (REPO_ROOT walk) | **green, 7:33** — Playwright ran to the end |
| Type Check UI | red at `check:side-effects-array` (3rd gate) | 15 gates pass; red at `check:icon-record-names` (see below); the type-check step still unreached |
| Test UI | 15/16 red, ~5–6 files per shard, readers | shards 1/4/9/14 read so far: 1–3 files each, none a reader |

**New cause — the merged tree resolves different dependency versions than objectui's lockfile.** The verify branch's lockfile was recomputed from the manifests' ranges (verify commit 717defb0ee), not carried over from objectui's `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and the git-root `pnpm-workspace.yaml` overrides now apply to every `ui/*` importer. Measured against objectui `main`'s lockfile: **138 importer×dependency rows moved across 69 packages** (308 unchanged). The ones that bite:

- `lucide-react` 1.43.0 → 1.61.0 (22 importers): the generated `lucide-record-icon-names.ts` drifts (+94/−9 names) → `check:icon-record-names` red in Type Check UI, 13 unit failures in `check-lucide-icon-record-names.test.ts` (shard 4). Verify commit d17ed5edf9 regenerates the list so run 4 reaches the type-check step; this is a measurement aid, not the fix.
- `@radix-ui/react-select` 2.3.7 → 2.4.1, `react-tooltip` 1.2.16 → 1.4.1 and 15 other radix minors: the remaining dom failures are all Select/Tooltip interactions — `ListView.fieldListRead-11984` (listbox never opens, waitFor timeout), `ListView.sortFieldFallback` (Select trigger renders no value text), `importWriteModes-12697` (option not found), `CreateViewDialog.chartBinding-11576` (listbox does not close on Escape), `PublicFormsPage.servedRule-11545`, and two accessible-description tests (`action-disabled-reason-11839`, `MarketplacePackagePage.installMode-12288`) where the tooltip's description is now emitted twice. These are the "unattributed dom tests" of run 1.
- Root override `react-router@<8.3.0 → ^8.3.0` (objectstack's advisory pin) rewrites the `react-router` **under objectui's `react-router-dom@7.18`** to 8.5.0 — a major mismatch inside one router line that happens to type-check and pass most tests; it must not ship.
- Root override `happy-dom@>=17 <22 → ^21.0.4` moves objectui's test DOM from 20.11.2 to 21.0.4 (major).
- `vite` 8.3.5 → 8.3.4 and `postcss` 8.5.31 → 8.5.28 went *down* (objectstack's pins win on shared ranges); harmless, but it shows the merged lock is objectstack's lock plus a fresh resolution of ui/, not a merge of two locks.

Full table: on #25697 (next comment). **Cutover bill (new, carried on #25697):** the import must splice objectui's lockfile resolutions into the merged `pnpm-lock.yaml` (ui importers keep objectui's resolved versions; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` then passes with zero moved rows), and the git-root overrides must be scoped so they do not rewrite a dependency line objectui owns (`react-router@>=8.0.0 <8.3.0`; `happy-dom` measured first). Filed as sub-issue 5a of #25677.

Also in run 3 (unchanged classes, no new comment): Lint lanes, Validate Package Dependencies (fixed group → 4a), PM dispatch-gates (ENOBUFS → PR A2), Test Core 2/4/5/6 (partitioner → PR A2). Build Core: pending at read time.

**Run 4 (40149547507 + the lint/type-check workflow run 40149547594, head d17ed5edf9) — read.** Verify commit: `ui/packages/components/src/lib/lucide-record-icon-names.ts` regenerated with objectui's own script (+94/−9 names) so Type Check UI could get past `check:icon-record-names`.

| Job | Reading |
|---|---|
| Type Check UI | `check:icon-record-names` and `check:i18n-keys` now green. Red at **`check:i18n-drift`**: `cannot read b77bb37eb2…:packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts — is b77bb37eb2 in this clone?` The ref IS in the clone (`git cat-file -t` → `commit`; it is objectstack's merge-base with `origin/main`) — the path is what is wrong: `git show <ref>:<path>` resolves `<path>` against the **repository root**, so under `ui/` it needs the `ui/` prefix whatever cwd the script spawns git with. New reader class, the second half of #25723: 31 `ui/scripts/*.mjs` spawn `git show` / `ls-tree` / `diff --name-only` / `ls-files` → **sub-issue 2d #25728** (`nestedPrefix()` from #25723's helper, or git's own `ref:./path` / `--relative`; plus a regrowth gate). The steps behind it were run locally in this tree: `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `type-check:scripts`, `type-check:vitest-config`, `type-check:e2e` all exit 0; the `turbo run type-check` over the ui packages against spec HEAD is still running — its error list is appended to #25727 (spec drift) when it finishes. |
| Test UI 1–16 | 16/16 red, same dom class as run 3 (shard 16 read: plugin-list sort-picker tests, `Unable to find an element with the text: Sort Records`, no `/add sort/i` button — radix Select under the recomputed lock) → **#25726** (dependency neutrality: lockfile splice + override scoping; patch in progress, becomes run 5). |
| Type Check · source gates | **First read this run.** Red at `Check every package is type-check covered or ledgered` (`pnpm check:type-check-coverage`): `Error: ui/tsconfig.json is not parseable, so its test coverage cannot be judged` — `readTsconfig` uses `JSON.parse`; objectui's root `tsconfig.json` is JSONC (44 comment lines). Reproduced locally. The gate now enumerates the 40 `ui/` workspace members because `pnpm-workspace.yaml` does. |
| Type Check · debt ledger | Red at `Re-measure the type-check DEBT / TEST_DEBT ledger` (`pnpm check:type-check-debt` = the same script with `--re-measure`) — the same `ui/tsconfig.json` parse error. |
| Type Check · consumer gates | Red at `Published-README export gate` (`pnpm check:published-readme-exports`): **exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET** — 19 `@object-ui/*` packages' built type entries (`ui/packages/*/dist/index.d.ts`) are absent, because the lane's "Build the nested packages the consumer gates resolve through" step builds the objectstack closure only. Nothing measured, no finding. Reproduced locally (exit 3). The other 19 gates in the lane are green, including `Type check downstream consumer contract`. |
| Lint lanes, Validate Package Dependencies, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Test Core, Build Core | Unchanged from the run-3 read (classes already recorded above: 17 lint-lane gates, 4a, PR A2, PR A2, spec drift / `@object-ui/site`). |

**Disposition of the three type-check lanes — PR A2 bill (objectstack-side, inert before cutover), on #25697 with the Test Core partitioner, `dispatch-gates.mjs` `runGit` maxBuffer and the root `build` filter:** `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` reads `tsconfig.json` through a JSONC-tolerant parse (TypeScript's own `parseConfigFileTextToJson`, or `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`), or excludes members under `ui/` until the cutover ledgers them; `scripts/check-published-readme-exports.mjs` scopes to the closure its lane builds (or the lane builds the `ui/` packages, ~7 min cold — the more expensive answer). Which of the two each gate takes is decided in PR A2 against AGENTS.md's gate rules, not here.

Next on this PR: run 5 = #25726's lockfile splice as a verify commit (re-measures Test UI); then the counter-probe (`ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` TS2339 must turn Type Check UI red), then this PR closes. Still DO NOT MERGE; no review requested.

**Run 6, new red class (one owner, no card): `@object-ui/cli#type-check` TS2321 in the merged layout.** Type Check UI now gets past `check:i18n-drift` (the 2d class is gone on CI, as measured locally) and into the turbo `type-check` graph for the first time: 65 of 79 tasks green, then `@object-ui/cli` fails with

```
src/utils/workspace-vite.ts(216,12): error TS2321: Excessive stack depth comparing types 'Plugin & ExportedAPI' and 'Plugin'.
```

Reproduced on the worktree at `7180ec63cc`. Cause: two `vite` type copies. The merged lock carries `vite@8.3.5` four times (peer sets keyed on `@types/node` 26.2.0 / 26.6.3, `esbuild` 0.28.1 / 0.28.2, `tsx` 4.23.12 / 4.23.15) and `@vitejs/plugin-react@6.0.5` twice; the copy linked under `ui/packages/cli` compares a `Plugin` from one vite instance with `Plugin & ExportedAPI` from the other, and tsc gives up. objectui standalone has one copy (its own lock pins `esbuild` 0.27.7 / `tsx` 4.23.12 for that peer set), so objectui's CI is green on the same source. This is the duplication `check:lockfile-integrity` reported before the push (26 packages, `@vitejs/plugin-react` among them), now with a red attached.

Measured fix: `pnpm dedupe` on the merged lock clears it (`@object-ui/cli` type-check exit 0, lock −1,937 / +206 lines). Cost against the 5a principle (objectui's resolutions kept): 50 of 527 `ui/` importer rows move, all onto versions objectstack already carries — `vitest` 4.1.10 → 4.1.12 (18 rows, plus `@vitest/ui`, `@vitest/coverage-v8`), `@types/node` 26.2.0 → 26.6.3 (11), `happy-dom` 21.0.4 and `better-auth` 1.7.12 (the two overrides already kept), `chalk` 6.0.1, `@testing-library/react` 16.3.3, `playwright` / `@playwright/test` 1.63.0, `eslint` 10.11.0, `turbo` 2.11.5, `ai` 7.0.118, `react-grid-layout` 2.3.0, `yaml`, `tsx`, `js-yaml`, `fs-extra`, `@changesets/cli`. No major moves; the run-4 class (react-router 7 → 8) is not among them.

Owner: cutover bill item 6 (dedupe or accept the split; `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/5-cutover-bill-notes.md`), carried by child 5's adaptation commit — no card, because the fix is a lock operation on the import, not code. Run 7 on this PR measures the dedupe option (Test UI 16 shards against the moved rows) once run 6 is read; the deduped lock is kept at hand. Unchanged plan: counter-probe after that, then this PR closes.
